title: UDLF deployment config — target-agnostic
description: Deploy-neutral config for `platform: udlf`. Names no product; the deployer decides what to build. Open, so unknown keys pass through unvalidated.

schema.description: Sub-schema revision this block was authored against, e.g. `udlf::0.1.0`.

severity.description: Severity for this deployment. Optional, overrides `detection_context.severity`.

mode.description: Whether this deployment alerts. `monitoring` runs without alerting. Absent means the deployer decides.

schedule.description: When the detection runs, in neutral terms. Open, so a target-specific key can ride along.

cron.description: Cron expression governing when the detection runs. Standard 5-7 field cron plus the `@`-shortcut forms.

lookback.description: How far back each run searches. Unconstrained: a relative-time modifier, plain duration or ISO 8601 period all work.
